session_summary: Phase 3: Grafana Alloy self-monitoring successfully deployed. All 10 containers running on EC2 (including alloy). 4,727 Prometheus series with client=sauron confirmed. Loki receiving logs with client=sauron label. Sauron Self-Monitoring dashboard provisioned in Grafana. One post-deploy fix required: Grafana admin password had to be manually reset via CLI because container first initialized before .env symlink was in place.

agent_feedback.worked_well: Produced correct Alloy River config on first attempt. Correctly identified the monitoring_monitoring external network name issue and fixed it. Created all Phase 3 files (config.alloy, docker-compose.monitoring.yml, alert rules, dashboard, docs) in a single invocation.
agent_feedback.needs_improvement: Did not catch the .env loading issue — ran docker compose from monitoring/ subdirectory in earlier sessions, causing containers to start with empty env vars. Should always run docker compose from project root with -f flag when compose file is not at root.
agent_feedback.suggested_change: Add a note to the devops-engineer template: when using docker compose with -f flag, always run from the project root directory so that .env at the root is picked up. Docker Compose V2 looks for .env in the compose file directory, not the CWD.

overall_notes: Key learnings captured in Alexandria (loki-grafana-stack guide): (1) GF_SECURITY_ADMIN_PASSWORD only applies on first DB init — reset via grafana cli if container started without correct env; (2) env() function deprecated in Alloy River — harmless warnings, still works; (3) loki.source.docker stale container errors after restart are benign; (4) Docker Compose .env loading — V2 looks in compose file directory, not CWD; use symlink or --env-file to bridge. Phase 3 DoD fully satisfied. Awaiting user signal before starting Phase 4.
